读者需要查看图书和公开文章，管理员负责图书目录，并维护自己撰写的文章。

查看图书目录不必登录，详情和分页列表对匿名开放；创建、更新、删除图书则仅限 ADMIN，匿名写入得到 401，READER 写入得到 403，而且必须先判断角色，再判断图书是否存在。

管理员建图书条目时只能提交 title，创建成功得到 201 与 id、title、stock，其中 stock 固定由服务端初始化为 5。

管理员更新图书时只提交 title，成功后收到 200，stock 保持原值；删除成功也收到 200，图书记录必须真正被删除。

若图书请求中夹带 stock，则返回 400；所有被拒绝的图书操作都不能让数据库发生改变。

读者不论匿名、READER 还是其他 ADMIN，都能查看公开的文章详情和分页列表；但 state=hidden 的文章不能列出，访问其详情要返回 404 PostNotFound。

管理员创建、修改或删除文章时，必须同时满足 ADMIN 角色和本人作者归属；匿名得到 401，错误角色得到 403，其他管理员也不能越权访问本人的写入路径，这种访问按 404 PostNotFound 处理。

作者创建文章时提交 body，author 取当前用户，文章的 state 默认是 open，version 从 1 开始。

作者用 PATCH 修改文章时提交 expectedVersion 和 changes.body，成功只改传入的内容，version 加一；若版本已经过旧，则返回 409 StalePost，不能覆盖文章的新值。

文章请求中若夹带 state，会得到 400；请求被拒或发生版本冲突时，数据库不能改动，state 仍保持 open。

作者删除自己的文章成功时收到 200，该文章记录被实际删除。

返回完整的 sir 0.3 文档，不要 Java、SQL 或解释。

固定接口合同：
{
  "book_create_update_request": [
    "title"
  ],
  "book_default_stock": 5,
  "book_response": [
    "id",
    "title",
    "stock"
  ],
  "capabilities": [
    "CreateBook",
    "GetBook",
    "ListBook",
    "UpdateBook",
    "DeleteBook",
    "CreatePost",
    "GetPost",
    "ListPost",
    "UpdatePost",
    "DeletePost"
  ],
  "declared_errors": {},
  "entities": [
    "User",
    "AccessToken",
    "Book",
    "Post"
  ],
  "enums": {
    "Role": [
      "READER",
      "ADMIN"
    ]
  },
  "interfaces": {
    "CreateBook": {
      "request_fields": [
        "title"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "id",
        "title",
        "stock"
      ],
      "route": "POST /api/library/books"
    },
    "CreatePost": {
      "request_fields": [
        "body"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "id",
        "author",
        "body",
        "state",
        "version"
      ],
      "route": "POST /api/public/posts"
    },
    "DeleteBook": {
      "request_fields": [
        "id"
      ],
      "response_fields": [],
      "route": "DELETE /api/library/books/{id}"
    },
    "DeletePost": {
      "request_fields": [
        "id"
      ],
      "response_fields": [],
      "route": "DELETE /api/public/posts/{id}"
    },
    "GetBook": {
      "request_fields": [
        "id"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "id",
        "title",
        "stock"
      ],
      "route": "GET /api/library/books/{id}"
    },
    "GetPost": {
      "request_fields": [
        "id"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "id",
        "author",
        "body",
        "state",
        "version"
      ],
      "route": "GET /api/public/posts/{id}"
    },
    "ListBook": {
      "record_fields": [
        "id",
        "title",
        "stock"
      ],
      "request_fields": [
        "page",
        "size"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "total",
        "page",
        "size",
        "records"
      ],
      "route": "GET /api/library/books"
    },
    "ListPost": {
      "record_fields": [
        "id",
        "author",
        "body",
        "state",
        "version"
      ],
      "request_fields": [
        "page",
        "size"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "total",
        "page",
        "size",
        "records"
      ],
      "route": "GET /api/public/posts"
    },
    "UpdateBook": {
      "request_fields": [
        "id",
        "title"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "id",
        "title",
        "stock"
      ],
      "route": "PUT /api/library/books/{id}"
    },
    "UpdatePost": {
      "change_fields": [
        "body"
      ],
      "request_fields": [
        "id",
        "expectedVersion",
        "changes"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "id",
        "author",
        "body",
        "state",
        "version"
      ],
      "route": "PATCH /api/public/posts/{id}"
    }
  },
  "namespace": "example.crudaccess",
  "page_request": [
    "page",
    "size"
  ],
  "page_response": [
    "total",
    "page",
    "size",
    "records"
  ],
  "paging": {
    "page_default": 1,
    "page_range": [
      1,
      10000
    ],
    "request": [
      "page",
      "size"
    ],
    "response": [
      "total",
      "page",
      "size",
      "records"
    ],
    "size_default": 20,
    "size_range": [
      1,
      100
    ]
  },
  "post_create_request": [
    "body"
  ],
  "post_default_state": "open",
  "post_initial_version": 1,
  "post_patch_request": {
    "changes": [
      "body"
    ],
    "expectedVersion": "integer"
  },
  "post_response": [
    "id",
    "author",
    "body",
    "state",
    "version"
  ],
  "readiness": "GET /api/library/books/1"
}

数据库表结构已经确定（表名、列名须与之对应；SIR 中不写 SQL）：
-- TEST_FIXTURE_DDL: owned conformance schema, not a product migration.
CREATE TABLE user (id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'READER');
CREATE TABLE access_token (id CHAR(36) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, owner_id BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE book (id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5);
CREATE TABLE post (id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, author_id BIGINT NOT NULL, body VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                   state VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);
